title: Been So Long
lyrics:
[id:$00000000]
[ti:It’s Been So Long]
[ar:CG5]
[al:It’s Been So Long]
[by:]
[00:00.00]It’s Been So Long - CG5
[00:05.08]Composed by：Yoav Landeau
[00:10.16]I don't know what I was thinking
[00:12.35]Leaving my child behind
[00:14.74]Now I suffer the curse and now I am blind
[00:19.79]With all this anger guilt and sadness
[00:22.44]Coming to haunt me forever
[00:24.77]I can't wait for the cliff at the end of the river
[00:29.95]Is this revenge I'm seeking
[00:32.18]Or seeking someone to avenge me
[00:34.75]Stuck in my own paradox
[00:36.50]I wanna set myself free
[00:39.74]Or maybe I should chase and find
[00:42.24]Before they try to stop it
[00:44.68]It won't be long before I become their puppet
[00:49.75]It's been so long
[00:51.81]Since I last have seen my son
[00:54.05]Lost to this monster
[00:55.85]To the man behind the slaughter
[00:59.66]Since you've been gone
[01:01.96]I've been singing this stupid song
[01:04.24]So I could ponder the sanity of your mother
[01:30.16]I wish I lived in the present
[01:32.11]With the gift of my past mistakes
[01:34.63]But the future keeps lurking
[01:36.11]In like a pack of snakes
[01:39.68]Your sweet little eyes
[01:41.58]Your little smile's all I remember
[01:44.74]Those fuzzy memories mess with my temper
[01:50.26]Justification is killing me
[01:52.36]But killing isn't justified
[01:54.71]What happened to my son I'm terrified
[01:59.71]It lingers in my mind
[02:01.63]And the thought keeps on getting bigger
[02:04.71]I'm sorry my sweet baby
[02:06.64]I wish I'd been there
[02:09.71]It's been so long
[02:11.82]Since I last have seen my son
[02:14.16]Lost to this monster
[02:15.85]To the man behind the slaughter
[02:19.60]Since you've been gone
[02:22.00]I've been singing this stupid song
[02:24.05]So I could ponder the sanity of your mother
